name: resource-watch
description: Shows which Claude Code session is using each booted Apple simulator, Claude Design project, the Xcode app, a local port or a file, above the prompt, and when another session already holds one this session picks up, toasts, messages that session and tells this session's agent.

hold.title: Hold (minutes)
hold.description: How long a session keeps a simulator, Claude Design project, the Xcode app or a file after its last tool call on it.
